name: TicTacToe
description: A simple tic-tac-toe game on a card on the SUPER DESKTOP desktop: play the computer or a friend, with a saved score. It opens the first time; after that SUPER DESKTOP starts with it open or closed, as you left it. A small # in the top bar opens and closes it.

surfaces.tooltip: Tic-tac-toe · click to open or close the game
